title: Cart Help
seo: Cart help chat to reduce drop off
meta: An assistant that answers questions in the cart about shipping, returns and sizes, to reduce drop off. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Cart help that answers questions before they leave
overview: Many shoppers pause at the cart over a small doubt such as delivery time, returns or whether an item will fit. We add a helper to the cart that answers those questions at once, using your own shipping, returns and product information. It offers short, clear replies, points to your policy pages and never blocks the checkout button. We test it on mobile and through the whole path to payment.

faq: We keep it light and do not place it over the checkout button. We test page speed before and after, and the helper can be switched off with one setting.
Only if you tell it to, with fixed rules such as a code at a set cart value. It never invents offers. By default it answers questions and leaves pricing to you.
Shipping times and costs, return rules, payment options, sizes and stock. We collect your real policies and write answers that match, and anything unclear is flagged to you before launch.
Can it see my customers' payment details?
No. It works only on the cart page, never on payment fields. We do not touch card data, and your payment provider handles checkout as before.
